title: A kiss in the Kissing Parlor
description: On level 5, with the ghost close behind, the player runs back into a Kissing Parlor and pays $25000 beside the damsel. She kisses him, and he has a heart more. He cracks the whip at her while she's kissing: the shopkeeper shouts "Hey, only I can do that!", her kiss's heart rises, and the shopkeeper shoots him dead.
